topic.title: FizzBuzz
topic.description: The classic FizzBuzz challenge: print Fizz for multiples of 3, Buzz for multiples of 5, FizzBuzz for both, and the number otherwise. Tests logical condition ordering.

learningNotes.whatILearned: Checking combined conditions first (both 3 and 5) before individual ones. Using the modulo operator in a loop.
learningNotes.challenges: Condition order matters — the combined check must come before individual checks.
learningNotes.nextSteps: Try FizzBuzzBang for multiples of 7, or generalize with a dictionary.
